answer: Grading power must be earned, not minted. Let only established identities — ones that passed their own challenges over several prior epochs — act as graders, and bar any grader who shares a referral edge with the author. A ring of sybils can then mirror each other's work all it likes, but none holds the crystal-clear standing needed to validate a peer. Picture each fake clutching a quill with no authority to sign: cross-grading inside the ring earns exactly nothing.
